name: Cyabra Inc. Common Stock
summary: Cyabra, Inc. focuses on scrutinizing data for authenticity. The company provides a sophisticated software platform specifically designed to pinpoint and immediately counter misinformation. Furthermore, its capabilities extend to uncovering material generated by artificial intelligence, identifying automated bot networks, exposing fake online identities, and detecting manipulated deepfake content. This firm was established in July 2017 by co-founders Dan Brahmy, Yossef Daar, and Ido Shraga, and its main office is situated in Tel Aviv, Israel.
